_doc: Flight model constants, read by scripts/sim/flight.gd. Units: mass in mass units, thrust in the thrust units of components.json (stats.thrust), positions in pixels, speed in px/s, angles in radians. Tile masses are not here: each tile in tiles.json has its own `mass` (unknown ids weigh 1.0). component_mass: whole-component mass by id; any component not listed weighs component_mass_per_cell times its footprint cells (both halves of a mount). The tier 1-2 weapons, engines, shields and reactors that took less room inside in playtest 2 (P2) are listed here at the mass they had before, so a ship does not get lighter and quicker for it; the medbay is not (it was never listed: 3 per cell). cable_mass_per_cell: mass of one cable cell. linear_damping and angular_damping: exponential decay rates per second for velocity and spin. thrust_to_accel: acceleration (px/s^2) = throttle x thrust x thrust_to_accel / mass. turn_factor: angular acceleration (rad/s^2) = turn x thrust x turn_factor / mass, times (turn_heavy_mass / mass) ^ turn_heavy_exp for a hull heavier than turn_heavy_mass (a big hull turns slowly enough to be flanked, docs/GUNS.md 13). max_speed: speed cap in px/s. controls.steer: "mouse" turns the ship toward the cursor at its turn rate (W/S thrust, A/D strafe on side engines); "keys" turns with A/D and the mouse only aims the gimbals (docs/CONTENT.md 4). Engines push opposite their nozzle (a hull mount's outward direction): forward thrust is the sum of thrust x cos(angle between the push and forward), strafe thrust the sideways part (flight.gd thrusts_of). side_share: every powered engine also gives this share of its thrust sideways, to the left and to the right, on top of the sideways part its direction gives, so a ship with only rear engines can still strafe (weakly) and side engines stay much better at it.
